name: Fish & Wildlife Foundation of Florida Discover Florida's Oceans Grants
summary: Grants funded by the Discover Florida's Oceans licence plate for projects that restore, enhance, protect or better understand Florida's marine, estuarine and coastal habitats.

status.quote: Applications must be submitted by September 30, 2026.

opens.quote: The 2026 Discover Florida's Oceans grant application will be open September 1-30, 2026.

deadline.quote: Applications must be submitted by September 30, 2026.

geography.quote: Projects focused primarily on general education or outreach, wildlife rehabilitation, or activities outside Florida will not be considered.

access.quote: Organizations that already have an account in the Foundation's grants management system may log in to access and submit the Discover Florida's Oceans grant application during the application period.

window.quote: The 2026 Discover Florida's Oceans grant application will be open September 1-30, 2026.

amount.quote: Grant requests of up to $50,000 will be considered, with most grants ranging from $1,000 to $25,000.

co_finance_required.quote: The ability to leverage matching funds or other resources may strengthen a proposal but is not a prerequisite for funding.
